 Search “Make Me Tingle” Episodes 5–6: Is This Rom-Com Finally Turning Up the Romantic Tension?
 Jon Lui 8 minutes ago 4 min read Nam Ji-hyun and Kim Jae-young are serving up the kind of awkward chemistry that makes K-drama fans pause, rewind, and immediately message their friends. 
 In Make Me Tingle , Gong Yeon-su believes in love but approaches relationships cautiously, while Dokgo Dal is a free-spirited CEO whose outlook challenges everything she has been taught. Their first blind date goes nowhere—only for them to cross paths again when Yeon-su takes on a marketing project for Dal’s adult-products startup. Talk about an unexpected second meeting! 
 Two opposites, one unexpected reunion! Will Yeon-su and Dal’s chemistry change in Make Me Tingle  Episodes 5–6? (TVING) Now, Episodes 5 and 6 arrive Thursday, October 22 , and fans have another chance to watch these opposites navigate professional pressure, uncomfortable conversations, and the possibility that their first impressions might not tell the whole story. 
 Will sparks fly, or will their differences keep getting in the way? Let’s look at what makes this rom-com one to watch—without pretending we already know what the new episodes reveal. 
 1. Yeon-su and Dal’s Opposite Personalities Are the Whole Attraction 
 Some K-drama couples fall for each other at first sight. Yeon-su and Dal? Their story is considerably messier—and that is part of the fun. 
 Yeon-su ( Nam Ji-hyun ) was raised in a traditional family where proper behavior and caution in relationships matter. Dal ( Kim Jae-young ), meanwhile, is an open-minded entrepreneur who approaches life from a very different perspective. Their contrasting beliefs create an unusual dynamic that follows them from their personal lives into the workplace. 
 Nam Ji-hyun (left) as Gong Yeon-su in Make Me Tingle (TVING) The twist is that neither can simply walk away when things get awkward. Yeon-su needs to do her job, and Dal is now her client. That means they have to keep interacting even when their views clash. 
 The question for fans:  Will working together help them understand each other—or give them even more reasons to disagree? 
 2. That Awkward Workplace Reunion Is Just the Beginning 
 Remember when Yeon-su met Dal on a blind date and neither seemed particularly interested in pursuing things further? 
 Their reunion as marketer and client changes the situation completely. Yeon-su takes on a new professional challenge and discovers that Dal’s company operates in a field she knows little about. Suddenly, she has to put her personal discomfort aside and figure out how to handle the assignment. 
 Still from Make Me Tingle (TVING) It is a setup with plenty of rom-com potential: unexpected encounters, uncomfortable conversations, and two people who must learn to communicate despite their differences. 
 And honestly, the best part is watching Yeon-su try to remain professional while navigating an unfamiliar environment. 
 K-drama fans, be honest:  Would you be able to work with someone you had already ruled out as a romantic prospect? 
 3. Yeon-su’s Personal Growth Could Be Just as Important as the Romance 
 It is tempting to focus entirely on whether Yeon-su and Dal will become a couple. But Make Me Tingle  also centers on Yeon-su’s changing perspective. 
 Her new assignment requires her to research love and sexual relationships more openly than she is accustomed to. That challenge brings her into conflict with her own assumptions, while her traditional family background adds another layer to the story. 
 That allows the series to explore how people learn about relationships beyond what they have always been told. 
 Still from Make Me Tingle (TVING) Yeon-su does not have to abandon her values to grow. Instead, the interesting question is whether she can become more comfortable discussing subjects that once made her uneasy—and whether Dal will challenge her assumptions in ways she never expected. 
 For viewers who enjoy romantic comedies with character development, this storyline could become just as compelling as the central pairing. 
 4. Episode 4 Set Up More Questions for the Next Two Episodes 
 Before diving into Episodes 5 and 6, it is worth remembering where the story left Yeon-su and Dal. 
 In Episode 4, Yeon-su’s event idea begins to take shape, giving her a concrete goal to focus on professionally. At home, however, Dal makes an overly blunt remark in front of her family, leaving everyone stunned. The contrast between Yeon-su’s work progress and her increasingly complicated personal situation keeps the tension alive. 
 Still from Make Me Tingle (TVING) That leaves fans with several questions going into the next release: 
 Can Yeon-su keep her new project on track while dealing with Dal’s unpredictable approach? 
 Will their personal history affect how they handle their professional relationship? 
 Can they learn to understand each other without constantly misreading one another? 
 These are questions to watch as the story continues—not confirmed Episode 5 or 6 plot reveals. The new episodes may answer some of them while introducing fresh complications. 
 5. Why K-Drama Fans Should Keep Make Me Tingle on Their Watchlist 
 If you love romantic comedies where the leads challenge each other, Make Me Tingle  has a premise worth following. 
 Nam Ji-hyun plays Yeon-su, a woman whose careful approach to love meets a major challenge, while Kim Jae-young plays Dal, the unconventional CEO who becomes both her client and an unexpected presence in her life. The series combines workplace comedy, family dynamics, and a romance built around two people with very different outlooks. 
 Its biggest draw is not simply the question of whether they will fall in love. It is watching them navigate the uncomfortable middle ground between their first impressions and the people they may discover underneath. 
 And with Episodes 5 and 6 arriving together, fans have a fresh opportunity to see how their relationship develops. 
 When to Watch “Make Me Tingle” Episodes 5–6 
 Release date:  Thursday, October 22, 2026 
 South Korea:  The series is a TVING original. 
 International viewing:  Viki lists the series, but availability may vary by region. Check your local platform listing for access and release timing.
